title: product slate — launch capture and quick log
content:
Morning capture — sprint day + launch prep (quick raw notes)

Goals for today:
- Lock PRD edits for post-launch telemetry section by EOD
- Confirm canary rollout window with infra and SRE
- Finalize fallback model list for latency incidents (shortlist 3)
- Quick sync w/ support about docs + KB stub

Timeline / micro-updates:
08:30 — quick stand: callouts: NPS metric owner still unassigned.
09:15 — PRD pass: trimmed feature matrix, moved rate-limit details to appendix. Need to add explicit token-cost examples.
10:00 — Design drop-in: UX asked to clarify 'auto-batch' toggle behavior. Action: Evan to draft microcopy.
11:00 — Infra 1:1: SRE flagged constraint on warm pools during canary. Need new fallback policy if warm pool unavailable.
12:30 — Lunch notes: think about making the telemetry opt-in default for enterprise? low appetite.
14:00 — Stakeholder sync: legal wants retention doc link + KMS entry. Marco to handle.
15:30 — Ops runbook review with Support: found 2 missing alarms (token spike, non-200 LRU hit).
16:45 — Quick dev triage: PR #87 needs a rebase and unit test for batching boundary.

PRD edits (concrete diffs I made / todo):
- Intro: added short "who benefits" para (ops, platform, customers).
- Requirements: clarified latency SLOs: 95th < 120ms for hosted tier, dedicated 95th < 60ms. (need sign-off)
- Telemetry section: added fields list (request_id, model_id, token_cost_estimate, latency_ms, kv_cache_hit) — TODO: add sample payload.
- Rollouts: added canary % steps: 1%, 5%, 25%, 100% with 30m observation windows. Update: SRE requests 60m for first two steps. Decide: keep 30m or extend? tag: decision-needed.
- Fallbacks: moved detailed fallback chain to appendix; shortlist: (1) quantized model variant, (2) reduced context length 50%, (3) region failover. Need to test sequence.

Launch checklist (quick run):
- [x] PRD final draft ready for review by stakeholders
- [ ] Telemetry sample payload added to PRD (owner: Samira) — blocked by infra schema example
- [x] Support KB skeleton (stub) created in Google Drive (link below)
- [ ] SRE canary window confirmed (owner: Marco) — pending
- [ ] Release notes draft (owner: Evan) — 50% done
- [ ] Legal retention statement in docs (owner: Marco) — waiting legal review
- [ ] Post-launch smoke tests defined and QA assigned (owner: QA lead)
- [ ] Rollback playbook with runbook IDs (owner: SRE)

Open questions / risks (short):
- Q1: If warm pool can't be pre-warmed in region X, do we auto-fallback to smaller model or route to next region? Cost vs latency tradeoff. (decision needed by EOD)
- Risk A: Token-cost regressions if batching not optimal — mitigation: pre-launch simulation runs with 3 traffic profiles.
- Risk B: Docs mismatch for enterprise customers on telemetry retention — legal + eng alignment needed.
- Unknown: Will support be able to triage KV cache issues at launch? Need a runbook training session.

Action items (who/when):
- Samira: add telemetry sample payload + example event (by 2025-08-13 noon).
- Evan: microcopy for auto-batch toggle + finish release notes first draft (by 2025-08-14).
- Marco: confirm canary windows w/ SRE + get legal retention note (by 2025-08-13 17:00).
- SRE (Ravi): run warm-pool feasibility test in us-west-2 and report numbers (by 2025-08-14).
- QA (Priya): prepare smoke test checklist and assign runners (by 2025-08-15).

Meeting snippets (copy-paste-ish):
- "If we see KV-cache miss > 10% during canary at 5% traffic, trigger rollback" — Ravi (SRE).
- "Legal needs explicit retention TTLs for telemetry, not just 'standard'" — Dana (Legal).
- "Make the fallback choice visible in Console and expose as a policy setting" — Evan (Design).

Notes to self (PM brain dump):
- Keep PRD lean; deep technical appendices are fine as linked docs. End-users of PRD are execs + eng leads.
- Avoid burying SLOs in appendix — call them out on page one.
- Don't forget to ask infra about expected cold-start latency distribution (p95/p99) for quantized models.

Useful links referenced here:
- PRD (working): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PROD/Slate+Launch+PRD
- Jira epic: SLATE-400 (epic board) and SLATE-412 (canary work)
- Support KB stub: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B_stub_support_slate
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/slate/pull/87

End-of-day reflection (quick):
- Progressed PRD a lot but still too many external blockers (SRE/legal). Prioritize aligning SRE first — that unblocks canary cadence and telemetry schema.
- Keep communication tight: short daily 15m canary sync until rollout complete.

Random scratch ideas (capture before I forget):
- Consider an internal "cost watch" dashboard that flags model variants with token-cost deltas > 10% post-deploy.
- Small experiment: opt-in telemetry detailed for first 100 enterprise customers to validate retention/PII handling.

---
Raw dump end. Will tidy before handing to stakeholders.
